name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement VQE in PennyLane with gradient
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement VQE in PennyLane with gradient descent for the H2 Hamiltonian (2-qubit Pauli form). Use a simple entangling ansatz, train for 150 steps with step size 0.2, and compare to exact diagonalization. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
